title: 23. Storage, CSI Snapshots & Velero DR
summary: Master stateful workload storage in Kubernetes: Container Storage Interface (CSI), dynamic PVC provisioning, VolumeSnapshots, and cross-region disaster recovery using Velero.
prerequisites: Object storage (AWS S3 / GCP GCS / MinIO)
learningObjectives: Configure production StorageClass resources with volume expansion and immediate/WaitForFirstConsumer binding
Create and verify point-in-time VolumeSnapshot and VolumeSnapshotClass resources
Schedule automated cluster-wide state and storage backups using Velero
Execute cross-cluster disaster recovery restore drills with zero data loss

curriculumModules.title: Container Storage Interface (CSI) & Volume Snapshots
curriculumModules.conceptSummary: CSI decouples storage plugins from the Kubernetes core. Through VolumeSnapshotClass and VolumeSnapshot, operators capture instantaneous copy-on-write storage snapshots across cloud block stores.
curriculumModules.productionArchitecturePattern: CSI volume expansion with automated pre-upgrade VolumeSnapshots for PostgreSQL and Kafka persistent volumes.

curriculumModules.title: Velero: Enterprise Backup, Migration & Disaster Recovery
curriculumModules.conceptSummary: Velero backs up both Kubernetes control plane resources (YAML) and persistent volume data (via CSI or restic/kopia) to cloud object storage for disaster recovery and cross-region migrations.
curriculumModules.productionArchitecturePattern: Automated 6-hour Velero backup schedules with 30-day retention and automated weekly restore drill validation.

labs.title: CSI Dynamic Storage Provisioning & VolumeSnapshots
labs.scenario: A stateful database requires dedicated persistent storage. Configure a high-performance StorageClass, deploy a 20Gi PersistentVolumeClaim, and capture a VolumeSnapshot before maintenance.
labs.productionContext: VolumeSnapshots provide fast recovery points without taking database pods offline.
objectives: Deploy a StorageClass named fast-nvme with allowVolumeExpansion: true
Deploy VolumeSnapshot database-snapshot-01 to capture the storage state
labs.starterManifest:
apiVersion: storage.k8s.io/v1
kind: StorageClass
metadata:
  name: fast-nvme
provisioner: ebs.csi.aws.com
volumeBindingMode: Immediate
allowVolumeExpansion: true
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: database-storage
  namespace: production
spec:
  storageClassName: fast-nvme
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 20Gi
---
apiVersion: snapshot.storage.k8s.io/v1
kind: VolumeSnapshot
metadata:
  name: database-snapshot-01
  namespace: production
spec:
  volumeSnapshotClassName: csi-aws-vsc
  source:
    persistentVolumeClaimName: database-storage

steps.title: Review StorageClass, PVC & Snapshot Manifests
steps.instruction: Open the Manifest Editor to inspect the fast-nvme StorageClass, database-storage PVC, and database-snapshot-01.

steps.title: Apply Storage Architecture
steps.instruction: Deploy the storage resources to the cluster.

steps.title: Verify PVC Binding Status
steps.instruction: Confirm that the PVC is created and associated with the fast-nvme StorageClass.

validationRules.name: fast-nvme
validationRules.remediation: Deploy StorageClass fast-nvme with allowVolumeExpansion: true.

validationRules.name: database-storage

labs.troubleshootingGuide: Verify that storageClassName in the PVC matches 'fast-nvme' exactly.

labs.title: Velero Cluster Backup and Disaster Recovery Drill
labs.scenario: Execute a full production disaster recovery drill using Velero. Submit a backup for the production namespace, verify backup completion, and log the audit record.
labs.productionContext: Disaster recovery readiness requires regular automated backup creation and periodic test restorations.
objectives: Submit a Velero backup named production-backup-drill
Inspect backup status using velero backup get
Deploy the dr-drill-audit ConfigMap in production
labs.starterManifest:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: dr-drill-audit
  namespace: production
data:
  backupName: "production-backup-drill"
  recoveryTier: "Tier-1-Mission-Critical"
  status: "success"

steps.title: Create Velero Backup
steps.instruction: Run velero backup create to capture the cluster state.

steps.title: Verify Backup Completion
steps.instruction: Check the status of Velero backups.

steps.title: Record DR Audit Log
steps.instruction: Apply the dr-drill-audit ConfigMap to record drill completion.

validationRules.remediation: Execute 'velero backup create production-backup-drill' in the terminal.

validationRules.description: ConfigMap dr-drill-audit exists in production with status success
validationRules.name: dr-drill-audit
validationRules.remediation: Apply the starter manifest to create the dr-drill-audit ConfigMap.

labs.troubleshootingGuide: Confirm that the backup name matches 'production-backup-drill' in the command.

assessmentQuestions.question: What does setting allowVolumeExpansion: true in a StorageClass enable?
options: It allows users to resize PVCs to a larger size without losing data or recreating the volume
It compresses all files on the volume by 50%
It automatically replicates the volume across all continents
It converts block volumes into NFS shares
assessmentQuestions.explanation: allowVolumeExpansion: true enables online or offline expansion of the underlying cloud block volume by editing the PVC storage request.

assessmentQuestions.question: How does Velero protect stateful Kubernetes applications across disaster recovery events?
options: By taking continuous video recordings of the dashboard
By backing up Kubernetes API manifests and invoking CSI VolumeSnapshot APIs to snapshot persistent disk data into cloud object storage
By cloning physical server motherboard firmware
assessmentQuestions.explanation: Velero orchestrates Kubernetes metadata backup alongside storage snapshots to cloud object stores for reliable recovery.
